status_code_data.description: The HTTP 431 Request Header Fields Too Large client error response status code indicates that the server refuses to process the request because the request's HTTP headers are too long.

meme_data.description: Comically Large Spoon, also known as Only a Spoonful, refers to a viral Vine by Vine user King Bach in which he pulls out a comically large spoon upon being told that he can only have a spoonful of ice cream. Starting in late May 2020, the Vine regained popularity through GIF captions and humorous edits.
